exact_statement_and_scope: For each nonempty fixed-word-avoiding class with the declared balanced-child cap, no single universal host exists under the stated injective adjacency embeddings. Changed caps, unrestricted host classes and edge-to-path embeddings are excluded.

plain_language.question: Can a single allowed structure contain every example in this restricted family?
plain_language.what_cannot_conclude: This does not rule out unrestricted hosts or a different notion of embedding.

plain_language.what_we_learned: No, under the stated branching cap and way of embedding one structure into another.
